5 The parties agree that no employee’s pay or Civil Service tenure rig hits in effect at the time of the implementation of the study will be adversely affected as a result of said implementation;

6 Any reclassification of a position title in unit 9 which results in a reduction in job group shall result in the “grandfathering” of the incumbent (specifically, the incumbent’s title shall be moved to the lower job group, but the incumbent shall be paid at the rate of the higher job group with all salary increases calculated on and added to the salary of the higher job group). The p provisions of this paragraph shall expire upon the execution of a successor collective bargaining agreement.
